scope: Successful catalogue results with numeric negative prices trigger named-tool choice for escalate_to_human. Existing tool executes and records the call normally. This is not a general detector for every possible record defect.

offline_checks.sdk_loop: Scripted model with normal SDK tool execution confirmed auto -> escalate_to_human -> auto -> auto for lookup, ticket creation, repeat lookup and reply.
boundaries: Unsuccessful/malformed lookup outputs do not trigger
Different caller context clears stored observations
Failed ticket result is not marked successfully reported and adds truthful-failure guidance
offline_checks.integrity: System prompt hash, fixed split and grading file hashes unchanged

limits: Forcing the next tool call relies on provider support for named tool choice; verify with the approved live batch.
Only product identifiers observed by this agent instance are tracked; no cross-session ticket lookup.
Successful ticket creation does not fix the catalogue data.
No new live model calls were made during preparation.
